# SenseAgri AI

> AI decision-intelligence platform for commercial poultry farms in South Africa. Unifies farm sensor data — temperature, humidity, air quality, feed, water, hen-day production — into welfare monitoring, disease early-warning and weekly ROI reports. Continuous sensing and causal AI, so operators understand *why* production changes, not just *what* changed.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.senseagriai.com/): product overview and positioning.
- [Solution](https://www.senseagriai.com/solution): how the platform works end-to-end — sensing in the house, edge AI on the farm, decisions on your phone.
- [Pricing](https://www.senseagriai.com/pricing): early-adopter pilot programme at reduced founder-rate pricing, scoped per operation.
- [About](https://www.senseagriai.com/about): the company, mission ("digital husbandry for African farms"), founders, values.
- [Contact](https://www.senseagriai.com/contact): book a pilot call.

## Facts

- **Product**: SenseAgri AI (also referred to as SenseAgri Farm AI in some alerts).
- **Category**: SaaS / decision-intelligence for commercial poultry operations.
- **Geography**: Based in South Africa; targets African poultry operations.
- **Delivery**: web dashboard + WhatsApp alerts.
- **Signals monitored**: temperature, humidity, air quality (CO₂, ammonia), feed, water, hen-day production, welfare indicators.
- **Founders**: Dylan Geldenhuys (Co-Founder & CEO, data scientist), Dr Ryan Nel (Co-Founder & COO, veterinarian).
- **Contact**: ryan@senseagriai.com
